page_title_verbatim: Monday Dip EA- Index Mean Reversion D1 - expert for MetaTrader 5
author: chen guang
name: Monday Dip Daily Index Mean Reversion with Optional IBS & MA Filter (D1)
economic_rationale: Monday equity index weakness often reflects weekend headline de-risking and institutional rebalancing flows that mean-revert over Tuesday-Wednesday sessions across major stock indices.
counterparty_mechanism: Weekend risk-off selling depresses Monday's daily close (optionally with low Internal Bar Strength IBS), which systematic dip-buyers and corporate/pension inflows absorb by Wednesday close.
entry_rule: Evaluated exclusively on closed D1 bars (max 1 trade/week): open Long on Monday close if Monday close < prior session (Friday) close; optional strict restrictive toggles require IBS = (Close-Low)/(High-Low) <= InpIBSMax and Monday close < D1 Simple Moving Average (InpMAPeriod).
exit_rule: Unconditional time-based exit at Wednesday's D1 close (executed at first tick of next session; fallback on Thursday/Friday close if Wednesday close missed).
stop_loss_rule: Mandatory percentage-based hard Stop Loss (InpStopLossPercent) respecting broker minimum stop distance; fail-safe immediate market close if 5 consecutive SL modification attempts fail.
take_profit_rule: No fixed price take-profit target; exits are purely time-based (Wednesday D1 close) or hard SL.
rule_description: Open-source D1 long-only index mean-reversion EA (US500, UK100, GER40): max 1 trade/week buying Monday close strictly below prior session close with optional IBS and D1 SMA filters, closing unconditionally on Wednesday D1 close, with mandatory percentage hard SL and 5-retry fail-safe emergency close. Zero grid, zero martingale.

raw_text: The Expert Advisor trades directly on whichever symbol chart it is attached to (no hardcoded symbols). It executes a maximum of one trade per week and all strategy decisions are calculated exclusively using Daily (D1) closed candle data based on server time. ⚡ Core Rules Rule 1 — Entry: On Monday close, the closing price is compared with the previous session's close (usually Friday). A long position is triggered only if Monday’s close is strictly lower than the prior trading day’s close. This check occurs only once per week. Rule 2 — Exit: The open position is automatically closed at Wednesday's daily close (executed at the first tick of the next daily session), regardless of profit or loss. If Wednesday close is missed, any subsequent daily close (Thursday, Friday, or weekend close) will trigger the exit. Rule 3 — Stop Loss & Safety: A percentage-based Stop Loss ( InpStopLossPercent ) is applied upon entry, respecting the broker's minimum stop distance ( SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL ). If 5 consecutive attempts to apply or modify the Stop Loss fail, the EA attempts an immediate market close to ensure capital safety. Note: There is no Take Profit target—exits are entirely time- and stop-based. 🛡️ Optional Entry Filters Both filters are optional toggles that can only restrict entries further (they will never create entries on their own or loosen Rule 1): Internal Bar Strength (IBS) Filter: Calculates IBS = (Close - Low) / (High - Low) for Monday's candle. Entry is permitted only if IBS <= InpIBSMax . If High equals Low, the day is ignored and logged. Moving Average (MA) Filter: Requires Monday’s close to be strictly below a Simple Moving Average ( InpMAPeroid ) calculated over closed D1 candles including Monday. ⚙️ Key Specifications Chart Timeframe: Timeframe independent (uses D1 series internally). Attaching to a D1 chart is recommended for clean log monitoring. Symbol Compatibility: Multi-index compatible (US500, UK100, GER40, etc.). Risk Management: Strict 1-position limit with robust retry logic for order execution and emergency closes. Inputs Input Default value Unit Meaning and effect InpLots 0.10 lots Fixed position size requested for every entry. It is floored to the symbol's volume step; a size below SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN aborts the entry (it is never rounded up), a size above SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX is clamped down to the maximum. InpStopLossPercent 10.0 percent of the entry price Distance of the stop loss below the entry price. If the broker's SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL demands a wider distance, the stop is widened. Values less than or equal to 0 are rejected at start-up: the EA does not run without a stop. InpMagic 20260922 identifier Magic number that marks the EA's own positions. Only positions on the chart symbol carrying this magic are counted and managed. InpMaxSlippagePoints 30 points Requested maximum deviation (slippage tolerance) for the market entry and the market exit. This is a tolerance request, not a guaranteed cap: the actually executed price also depends on the broker's execution mode and policy. InpTradeComment "MonDip long" text Comment attached to the entry order, visible in the terminal's trade history. InpUseIBS true on / off Enables the optional IBS entry filter (see below). The filter can only make entry stricter. InpIBSMax 0.25 ratio in (0, 1] Maximum allowed IBS of the Monday bar. Values outside (0, 1] are rejected at start-up. InpUseMA true on / off Enables the optional long-term moving-average entry filter (see below). InpMAPeriod 180 daily bars Period of the simple moving average of daily closing prices, computed on closed D1 bars ending with the Monday bar. Values below 2 are rejected at start-up. InpVerboseLog true on / off Prints additional journal detail. The weekly decision line is always printed regardless of this switch.
